certifiedResults.title: Kentucky official presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: County-level presidential rows are parsed from the official Kentucky State Board of Elections 2024 General Election Certification as amended on December 9, 2024. The parser reconciles county candidate sums against the PDF Total Votes row.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Official Kentucky State Board of Elections certification PDF for the November 5, 2024 General Election, amended on December 9, 2024.

wardDetail.title: Kentucky county review comparison
wardDetail.detail: County review rows are loaded from the official Kentucky State Board of Elections certification PDF by comparing President and Vice President county rows to U.S. House district county rows aggregated across all six congressional districts. Districts 4 and 5 do not include Democratic columns, so the app carries a methodology warning.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Official Kentucky State Board of Elections certification PDF for the November 5, 2024 General Election, amended on December 9, 2024.

turnout.title: Kentucky official county turnout
turnout.detail: County turnout rows are parsed from the official Kentucky State Board of Elections Voter Turnout Report for the 2024 General Election. The report includes total registered voters, number voting, and party registration/voting columns by county. Kentucky's turnout page says reports are run after registration rolls reopen, so these rows are warning-labeled as post-election denominators.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Official Kentucky SBE turnout PDF is dated January 6, 2025 and titled Voter Turnout Report For the 2024 General Election.
